name: a-property-fails-for-one-signal
note: EXPR §6: missing data is an error, not null. The signal has no `n`, so the expression fails for that signal only — the instance is untouched and the block reports ERR_EXPR as its status. The `error` call after it is the block saying why through ABI §7.0 — a status code names the kind of failure and the detail names this one.
